entries.source_evidence: Player: "Let’s make camp somewhere nearby and tend to wounds. We’ll leave in the morning." Following Day266 post-troll search, V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar relocate the intact four-horse coach a short distance along the established road into a sheltered clearing behind a low wooded rise, horses tethered safely, without inventing a town, new surveyed milepost or another night266 encounter roll (already spent). Night watch and mundane wound care are independently and safely arranged; actual night266->267 is peaceful and fully qualifies as an overnight wilderness Short Rest. Standing explicit V Second Wind pre-planned-rest delegation applies: V HP27/48, Second Wind ready1/1; genuine executed Python secrets d10 FACE1 + Fighter level3=4 healed, V HP27->31, Second Wind1->0 before the rest and0->1 after successful Short Rest. V Psi6/6 so standing pre-rest Psi Recovery use does NOT apply. V refuses no specific HD but has not authorized HD spending: all V Hit Dice remain7/7, no other V healing. Fenar DM-controlled independently spends THREE of her available FIVE Barbarian d12 HD at completed wilderness Short Rest; actual executed Python secrets faces9,4,9 with CON+2 each heal11+6+11=28, Fenar17/59->45/59, HD5->2/6. A fourth separately drawn face was not consumed or applied and is not counted as an event. Cirren HP49/51 conserves HD5/6 and spells. All normal Short Rest features actually refresh: V Action Surge0->1, Superiority Dice0->4, Second Wind0->1; V MartialPoints7/7 and PsiRecovery1/1 remain full; Fenar MP6/6 full, Rage2/4 and Shift1/3 unchanged (Long Rest recovery only); Cirren ChannelDivinity2/2 unchanged, spell slots L1=0/4 L2=1/3 L3=2/3 unchanged. No auto HP or spell/rage recovery. Fenar Rage/Shift and Cirren Spiritual Weapon were already expired in prior fifteen-minute aftermath, no active timed combat conditions. Quiet qualifying wilderness overnight after the combat resets began Long Rest progress0/6 ->1/6 by DAWN267, no full Long Rest. At dawn Day267, Mara/Cirren/Fenar eat and horses fed; one normal once-per-day allocation three ration-person-days and four feed animal-days, carrying rations18->15 and horse feed24->20; no duplicated Day266 debit, no coins spent. Coach harnessed with all four healthy owned horses and travel resumes on original route towards legal western Veyr crossing via Caer Veylan, Eastwatch and Nightglass Hall. No Day267 daytime encounter rolled or full-day arrival, no quest/world event invented. Day267 early morning party rolling out, V next action unchosen, no further play-time advancement.

entries.source_evidence: Player exact directive "Yes, camp, second wind, continue" after Day267 late-afternoon westbound travel with no daytime encounter. Camp is an exposed lightly wooded ordinary trade-road clearing off original Crownsunder->western Veyr crossing road, no town/arrival. V standing pre-rest Second Wind at HP42/48, feature1/1: genuine Python secrets d10 FACE6 + Fighter level3=9, capped to missing6 HP; V HP42->48/48 and SecondWind1->0 before rest. Wilderness weighted LongRest prior1/6 resets0/6 due use of significant limited combat feature while still on wilderness recovery chain; no new rest completion. Camp night genuine occurrence d100 FACE4 vs ordinary road exposed night01-07 => EVENT. Type genuine d100 FACE10 in creature/monster category01-42. A predeclared eight-outcome eligible forest candidate table for this specific Crownsunder roadside woodland:1-2 dire wolves,3-4 owlbear,5 giant spiders,6 giant boar,7 ankheg,8 displacer beast; genuine d8 FACE1 selects dire wolf pack. Independent predators stalking horse scent and prey, hostile hunting motive but no compelled suicidal battle; genuine severity d100 FACE32 => serious band31-75, predeclared fixed roster EXACTLY seven 2014 Basic Rules/MM Dire Wolves, CR1 XP200 each, 7 foes 1400 base xp x2.5=3500 adjusted, serious/hard vs house three level7 budget3300 Hard and5100 Deadly. Source 2014 Dire Wolf original legacy/Basic Rules verified: Large beast unaligned, AC14 HP37 each, speed50, Dex+2 initiative, Perception+3(passive13), Stealth+4, Keen Hearing/Smell, Pack Tactics, Bite+5 reach5 2d6+3 piercing and DC13 STR save prone. No spellcasting, darkvision, resistance, immunity, extra attacks. Third-hour nighttime occurrence genuinely d8 FACE3 from uniform eight hourly bins after camp was settled; this is BEFORE the 4-hour Reborn wilderness Short Rest, and before companions' 8-hour overnight Short Rest. No ShortRest or HD recovery at this alert, no Second Wind refresh, and no dawn Day268 or supplies allocation. Cirren passive Perception23 detects multiple heavy paws/brush movement, Fenar keen smell corroborates, both issue warning to V and Mara; none surprised automatically, no stealth/initiative/attacks/damage from wolves. Four healthy horses tethered north of intact parked coach, Mara near coach. Campsite geometry fixed for any initiative: x axis east-west road y=0; coach center(0,+12), horses tethered(-20,+32), fire(+8,+5), Cirren watch(+15,-10), Fenar near fire(-8,+5), Mara near coach(-5,+12), V motionless resting within coach vicinity but his exact stance/tile unchosen. Southern treeline y<-35, western/northern low wooded rise y>+50, scattered trunks half cover if line crosses actual thick trunk, brush lightly obscured at forest edge, firm drivable road and coach exit west. Seven wolves starting positions W1(-75,-65), W2(-25,-85), W3(+30,-80), W4(+80,-60), W5(+100,+15), W6(+75,+85), W7(-80,+90), approaching in loose encircling crescent 75-130ft from camp; from horse nearest approx80-105ft. They have not charged or attacked, pack motives horse prey, avoidable/repellable and may retreat if soundly resisted. Player first hears movement and low growls and sees intermittent large canine silhouettes at firelight edge; precise number not automatically known from visibility; Cirren warns. Not a second troll encounter or faction/ancestry event. Current V HP48/48 SW0/1 HD5/7 (Fighter1d10 Rogue4d8), ActionSurge1/1 Superiority4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7; Fenar45/59 HD2/6 Rage2/4 Shift1/3; Cirren49/51 HD5/6, slots L1=0/4 L2=1/3 L3=2/3. No further V actions chosen. Day267 daytime had been quiet (d10051); Day267 night event is its single occurrence. Day266 and Day267 are consecutive random-event travel days, so Day268 ordinary travel day is mandatory quiet for random day/night checks if reached; quest/choice consequences still possible. Day267 daily rations/feed were already deducted at dawn (15 ration-days/20 animal-feed days left), no night debit.
